title: Q-ROOT-repeated-failure: repeated-failure keeps recurring: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe repeated-failure
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `repeated-failure` recurred on 5 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a loop failed the same way again and no change altered the approach
Guard: `grep:foundation/failure_audit.py::def _mode`
Remedy: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.
Symptoms seen:
- temporal:e5ddf8e610: ledger:executor:pr-outcome pr-outcome: 1 failures in a row, 3 in the last 3 days against 5 in the 11 before
- temporal:67d6a95a40: ledger:clocks:all all: 238 failures in a row, 212 in the last 3 days against 10 in the 11 before
- temporal:4f9b20023a: ledger:executor:pr-outcome pr-outcome: last event 67 h ago, it used to arrive every 1.6 h (42.8 intervals)
- temporal:bfbb87dc25: ledger:deploys:ultrastable-agents ultrastable-agents: last event 31 h ago, it used to arrive every 1.0 h (31.4 intervals
- temporal:381e97ef1d: ledger:deploys:ultrastable-dashboard ultrastable-dashboard: last event 31 h ago, it used to arrive every 1.0 h (31.4 int
- temporal:458cb625ba: ledger:deploys:ultrastable-seed-second-tenant ultrastable-seed-second-tenant: last event 31 h ago, it used to arrive eve
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe repeated-failure


**Evidence:** closing probe passed (7 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): guard passes; last occurrence 2026-11-21
